Description states trace values decrease to about 2.6 × 10⁻⁵ at rank 16, but figure shows approximately 4.0 × 10⁻⁵.
Description states trace values increase to roughly 4.6–4.8 × 10⁻⁵ at rank 64, but figure shows approximately 4.0 × 10⁻⁵.
Description states trace values rise to about 6.1–6.4 × 10⁻⁵ at rank 256, but figure shows approximately 4.0 × 10⁻⁵.
